gaps.description: performCalculation method contains placeholder logic that returns mock value (kpi.getCurrentValue() + 1.0). Real KPI calculation engine needs implementation with formula parsing, data fetching from source domains, and aggregation logic.
gaps.recommendation: Implement proper KPI calculation engine with: 1) Formula parsing and validation, 2) Data fetching from configured source domains, 3) Aggregation logic application, 4) Error handling for calculation failures
